summary: Verified Vercel Python dependency fix. Fresh uv venvs on Python 3.14.9 and 3.12.15 install /app/frontend/requirements.txt with --only-binary pydantic-core,pymongo,bcrypt successfully (pydantic 2.12.5 / pydantic-core 2.41.5, fastapi 0.121.3, starlette 0.50.0, pymongo 4.15.5, bcrypt 4.3.0). Imported /app/frontend/api/index.py (identical to backend/server.py) with VERCEL=1 and dummy env; TestClient: 17/17 checks pass on both versions (health, track/visit, contact valid 200 / invalid email 422, login, admin stats/visitors/contacts/me 200 with Bearer & 401 without, bad login 401, cron/digest 401 without auth, scheduler not started under VERCEL, bcrypt $2b$). No startup crash. beskarit_vtest dropped. Preview regression: health 200, admin login 200 with httpOnly Secure cookie, admin endpoints 200/401, cron 401.

minor.issue: FastAPI emits DeprecationWarning 'on_event is deprecated, use lifespan' (non-fatal on 3.12 and 3.14). Optional: migrate to lifespan.

Existing regression tests test_stats_spam_retention.py::test_stats_structure and ::test_contacts_include_score fail because they depend on pre-seeded data (spam block test-bot@x.com, contact with recaptcha_score 0.9) that is no longer in the preview DB. Test-data issue, not an app bug. 32/34 others pass.

action_items: Optional: replace @app.on_event('startup') with a lifespan handler to drop the deprecation warning
Optional: make test_stats_spam_retention.py seed its own spam block / scored contact so it does not rely on existing data
critical_code_review_comments: One run of uv pip install on 3.14 aborted (core dump) once; immediate retries (including --no-cache) succeeded. It looks like a transient local uv crash, not a dependency problem.
frontend/api/index.py is a manual copy of backend/server.py. The two can drift apart; consider a build step or symlink.

success_rate.backend: 100% (Vercel runtime checks 17/17 on 3.14 and 3.12; preview regression all pass)

seed_data_creation: Temporary beskarit_vtest DB (dropped). One TEST contact and one track visit were made only in the temp DB.
